blocking: B1 - The whisker-length evidence is measured from the wrong root. The palette's length_source measures the longest right whisker from a pad point at (680,392) to its tip at (527,450): 164 px = 61 mm, used as a lower bound of at least 61 mm. A high-pass 4x crop of ref.jpg (x 510-720, y 360-470) shows the whiskers converge and leave the pad at about photo x 642-655, y 388-400. (680,392) sits among the rostral follicle spots, about 26 px (10 mm) from the midline. The palette's own layout puts the longest whiskers (arc 1) at the pad's caudal end, and the Phase 1 roots are at |x| 18-23 mm. That root position matches x 645-655, not 680. From (645,390) the chord to the tip is about 132 px = 46-50 mm, not 61 mm. On the left side, the root by symmetry is at x 760-770, so the chord to (863,394) is about 36-39 mm, not 47. The table's 66 mm for rows B and C therefore needs an unstated tilt of about 42 deg out of the image plane, not 25 deg. Fix: re-derive the length table and the +-6 mm reference used by C13 check (e) from the correct root, or flag the lengths as estimates with the true lower bound.

B2 - Four of the five tactile types are underdefined. tactile_genal, tactile_chin and tactile_carpal give no taper (base:tip ratio), no curvature or total turn, no stiffness and no follicle depth, and they have no 'inherits' key. tactile_supraorbital's curvature_total_turn_deg 25 and follicle_root_depth_mm 2.0 carry no source and no confidence (G2). fur_plan.md's C13 whisker_check takes its ranges for clauses (b) follicle depth, (d) base:tip 7-13 and (g) turn from the palette, so for these types those clauses have no reference. A builder could grow untapered, clay-like cheek, chin or wrist whiskers, and the check could not fail them. This breaks the palette's own claim that each type fully defines its hairs.

B3 - The photo-side probes run through a camera that is not in Tripo's frame. pigment_project.py lines 40-42 state that camera_frozen.json was fitted in the canonical Rodin-axis frame, not Tripo's: Tripo's silhouette IoU through it is 0.52. I projected the eyes.json iris centres (head frame, via partition.head_local) through it. They land at x 607.7 and 486.4 px, against ref_points eye.L 763 and eye.R 651: about 150 px off. No camera_registered.json exists. These all rest on that camera: the C14 furnishing comparison ('photo ear crop through the frozen camera', fur_plan.md section 5), the C9 render re-measure, and the palette's 0.349 mm/px scale cross-check ('1.81 m to the muzzle'). Each would misregister against a skin built in Tripo's frame. Fix: register the camera with pigment_project.py --register, have the orchestrator approve it, and use only that camera.

B4 - The canal check passes when there is no canal. The palette's ear_canal rule says 'zero follicles inside the canal opening + 2 mm ramp', but no canal opening is defined anywhere. The palette gives no head-frame position for it. A grep for canal and meatus finds nothing in structure_inventory.json or tripo_rebuild/layers/ears*.json. Tripo's ear is a closed conch. So C14's 'zero roots in the canal' passes trivially on a canal-less skin, which is exactly Tripo's artefact. Fix: the canal opening must be a Stage 3 inventory part with a stated position and source, and ear_hair_check must fail when it is missing.
should: S1 - C13 check (g) tests smoothness and total turn only, not how the curvature is distributed along the whisker. The v37 whiskers (engine/tools/accessories.py whisker_set) droop as a parabola, so they bend most at the root. Luo & Hartmann give k(0) ~ 0, flat at the base, so the curve shape should be tested too. Add a profile clause, for example that the mean curvature of the first 20 % of the length is under a third of the last 20 %.

S2 - C13 has no negative controls. Run whisker_check on Tripo's whiskers.json prisms and on the v37 accessories.py whiskers, and record which clause catches each. The v37 whiskers are hair_curves (CURVES) with a 4x3 layout and a base:tip ratio of about 12.7. Clauses (a), (d) and (f) pass them; only (b) catches them (root only 0.8 mm under the skin), plus (c) (base 0.38 mm against a 0.32 mm maximum).

S3 - Clause (e) compares the built whiskers to the palette's own table, not to the photo. Add a photo-side probe: project the built fan through the registered camera and compare it with the whisker lines traced in the photo (tip positions and chord angles).

S4 - The recipe is not buildable for some tactile groups. Supraorbital roots ('above the medial half of the upper lid') and the chin tuft have no head-frame coordinates; genal has a prose estimate only. Give root boxes in head-frame mm, from the eyes.json canthi and mouth.json, so clause (f) can test group membership.

S5 - Nothing stops the 3 mm (range 2-4) mystacial follicles from reaching the upper canine, the maxilla or the oral vestibule. The skull is in packs/felid/skull, and row D sits about 3 mm above the mouth-corner level. C13 clause (b) tests only the minimum depth. Add a maximum-depth and clearance test.

S6 - Hairs could close Henry's pocket. The palette puts 1-3 mm hairs at 2/mm2 inside the slot and ear_back hair on the flap. Nothing tests strands passing through skin, so hair could bridge the slot and bring back C6b's 'slot closed by fill' failure. Add a strand-through-skin test for the pocket and the pinna walls.

S7 - lid_margin has no probe. Nothing catches hairs on the lower lid, or hairs piercing the cornea under the lid overhang (eyes OPEN B2: 0.3-1 mm). The 'pigmented variant follows the map' it refers to is never defined.

S8 - Two numbers are cited wrongly. The pad_extent source says 'nose leather lowest z -14 (nose.json)', but nose.json bottom_z_mm is -16.6 / -16.3 / -16.18; -14 is only the lowest width level. Re-justify row A at z -14.0, which sits about 2.6 mm above the leather bottom. Also, 'Phase 1 root_dir_head hints agree in sign (caudal)' is not true for every root: the y component is -0.16 and -0.21 for two left roots and -0.30 for one right root.

S9 - The ear facing values (~27 deg down, 37-39 deg outward) are called 'Phase 1 ears, sound', but facing is not on PHASE1_SUMMARY's sound list. REVIEW_ears B1 changes the right ear's facing disagreement from 3.45 deg to 0.44 deg; label it self-proven with the B1 caveat. Also drop the camera-based 0.349 mm/px, which comes from the camera in B3, and keep the iris-based 0.38 (+-5 %). Settle the conflict with coat.json's 0.27 mm/px before C8 uses coat.json lengths.

S11 - Base diameter rests on one cross-species relation (rat, Belli 2017) at low confidence. Before C13 clause (c) is proven, record a second bracket, or the photo's upper bound (strands 1-2 px wide), as an explicit range check.
